parsed_json.up: Select exact IC50 activity values in nM for compounds tested against human Cytochrome P450 3A4. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records, docs, activities, assays, and target_dictionary. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to require canonical_smiles. Filter by target name 'Cytochrome P450 3A4' and organism 'Homo sapiens' (tax_id 9606). Filter by standard_type 'IC50' and standard_units 'nM'. Keep only exact measurements where standard_relation is '='. Do not deduplicate; return every qualifying activity row. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
